description: PeckList's dependency updates. Renovate runs weekly from a separate runner project. Patches and minors merge themselves once the merge request's pipeline passes; majors wait for a person.

packageRules.description: Patches and minors: merge when the pipeline passes (one runner builds everything, so they are grouped below)
Engine ranges and the mise tool versions stay ranges (node 24, pnpm 10): a pin there made pnpm refuse every other Node 24
Majors need reading the changelog first
Capacitor core, CLI, Android and plugins move together
Test and lint tooling, one merge request
Base images float on their major tags (node:24, dotnet 10.0): no pins to exact tags or digests (a pin to node:24.22.2 would then never move), only majors are proposed, by hand
The Android build's Gradle plugins and SDK levels: by hand (they track Capacitor's template)

The Kubernetes examples run the newest release (PL-120): the tag in base and in the backup component moves together, merged when the pipeline passes (scripts/check-kubernetes.sh checks they match). Pre-releases are never proposed while the tag is a release
A major release of the Kubernetes examples' image (0.x to 1.0, and on) can break things: proposed, never merged by itself

Every patch and minor in one merge request a week: merges must be up to date, so six at once would each wait for and rerun after the others. Last, so it wins over the groups above; majors keep those groups
